name: Temperature trend
description: Change in annual mean air temperature at 2 m.
source: NASA POWER, MERRA-2 monthly (Zarr), variable T2M
limitations: MERRA-2 is a model-assimilated reanalysis, not direct station observations. Grid cells are ~50 km wide; a cell does not represent a country or region. Annual values are autocorrelated, so p-values may be optimistic. With ~200,000 cells tested at 5%, about 5% would look significant by chance. A significant trend does not establish cause.

name: Vegetation greenness (EVI)
description: Monthly Enhanced Vegetation Index from MODIS Aqua. Compare dates to see greening or browning.
limitations: Rendered imagery only: no trend statistics. Compare dates by eye; seasonality dominates.

name: Ocean chlorophyll (bloom indicator)
description: Daily chlorophyll-a concentration from MODIS Aqua, an indicator of phytoplankton blooms.
limitations: Daily swath data with gaps from cloud and orbit. Rendered imagery only: no trend statistics.

name: Deforestation
source: None selected: no deforestation layer found in NASA GIBS
limitations: Needs a vetted source, e.g. Hansen/Global Forest Watch tree-cover loss, or a proxy such as MODIS land cover (GIBS MODIS_Combined_L3_IGBP_Land_Cover_Type_Annual, 2001-2024). Not available yet.
